verdict.rationale: Copilot documents automation-style features: multi-step Cowork tasks, Browse with Copilot actions, and automating repetitive tasks. That makes the axis applicable, but nothing in the evidence shows versioning, reviewing change history, or rolling back automations. Deleting conversations and real-time step visibility are adjacent controls, not automation version control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
